senses.def: If I have correctly remembered the details.
A type of money collected from earnings on one race which is then automatically applied to a subsequent race in the case when an if-bet is placed.
It is fruitless to speculate about counterfactual situations.
ex:
"We would have won the match if we'd had a decent goalkeeper."
"And if my aunt had balls, she'd be my uncle!"
